title: Cost per active student per month
notes: Reuses scripts/sage-ai-accountability.mjs's buildProviderMix()/buildCostReport() (this session added exports for both, no CLI behavior change) over the trailing 30 days from AuditLog(targetType="ai_request") and LlmCallLog, connected via BENCH_PROD_READONLY_URL rather than the script's own DATABASE_URL default. 'Active student' = distinct LlmCallLog.studentId in the window (an aggregate count only; no student id is ever logged or included in output). usd_per_active_student_month has NO static config floor: config/sage-budget.json.monthlyBudgetUsd ships null on purpose (see that file's notes — a guessed ceiling would let a real overrun read as 'under budget'), and even once Britt sets it the floor is budget/activeStudents, a number that moves with enrollment and cannot be a fixed value in this file under the current {unit,direction,floor} contract shape. Until then, and until config/sage-budget.json.pricePerMtok has a verified rate for the live model, this ships as info; the scorer still computes and returns the would-be floor and VisionQuest's existing budgetCheck verdict (ok/warning/no_price/no_budget) in metrics[0].details for a human or a future runner enhancement to read. cloud_calls_total and local_calls_total are always computable and always info — the FERPA routing floor lives in the sibling ferpa-routing suite, not here.
